how_to_apply: Go to the official website dgll.nic.in and download the notification and application form.
Fill up the application form strictly in capital letters on A4 size good quality paper.
Paste your recent passport size colour photograph (size 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, not more than 3 months old, not to be attested) in the designated space and sign below the photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents as proof of date of birth, educational qualifications, and category certificate.
Provide your left-thumb impression and signature at the bottom of the application form.
Place the application and documents inside an envelope.
Superscribe the application with "Application for the post of Navigational Assistant Grade - III".

Send the application by Speed Post / Registered Post to The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, "Deep Bhavan" Port Residential Area, Saligrampuram, Visakhapatnam-530024, Andhra Pradesh so that it reaches on or before 01/11/2026 at 1700 Hrs.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted in A4 size good quality paper only. Non-submission of required documents at Serial No.21 of the application will lead to the rejection of the application. Candidates presently employed in Central/State Government, Autonomous bodies, PSUs, Public Sector Banks must apply "through proper channel" or submit "No Objection Certificate" along with the application else the application will be rejected. Initial posting shall be at any Lighthouse/DGSS/NAVTEX Station under Visakhapatnam Directorate and liable to be transferred anywhere in India. In case the closing date happens to be a public holiday, the next working day will be the last date for receiving of applications. Department will not be responsible for any postal delay.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting DGLL Navigational Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL), Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DGLL Notification 06/2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Navigational Assistant Grade-III post reserved for the Scheduled Caste category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DGLL Navigational Assistant Grade-III?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications is 01-11-2026 up to 1700 Hrs (with an extended date of 08-11-2026 for specified remote regions).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Electronics or Telecommunication or Electronics and Communication or Electrical and Electronics from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DGLL Navigational Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 and 27 years as of 01-11-2026, with age relaxation applicable for Scheduled Caste candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DGLL Navigational Assistant Grade-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled offline application in A4 size paper along with necessary documents via Speed Post or Registered Post to the Visakhapatnam address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test and a trade test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary scale for Navigational Assistant Grade-III?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in Level-5 in Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q10. Where will be the initial posting after selection?
faq.answer: Initial posting shall be at any Lighthouse under DGSS/NAVTEX Station under Visakhapatnam Directorate with liability to be transferred anywhere in India.
